changes: Resolved all 23 seed skills in packages/domain/src/taxonomy/panama-skills.taxonomy.json to released ESCO v1.2.1 concept URIs and recorded each concept's verified English preferred label in escoLabel.
Added escoVersion, escoResolvedAt, and escoResolution to the taxonomy and rewrote provenance to record the ESCO release and resolution method.
Extended SkillTaxonomy and TaxonomySkill with the ESCO provenance fields and an optional escoUnmappedReason for explicitly unmapped skills.
Added an ESCO taxonomy contract test covering URI format, uniqueness, recorded version, unmapped reasons, and preservation of localized labels.

commands: live ESCO API verification: 23/23 concepts returned status=released with matching preferred labels at selectedVersion=v1.2.1
validation.notes: The taxonomy test passed 10/10, typecheck passed, the full suite passed 492/492 across 54 files, and gate:ci passed the coverage thresholds. All 23 URIs were re-fetched from https://ec.europa.eu/esco/api/resource/skill?selectedVersion=v1.2.1 and matched their recorded escoLabel with status=released. npm run lint still reports 8 pre-existing @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars errors in apps/web/app/api/* routes; none are in the files changed here.

riskRemaining: ESCO concept selection is semantic: several original seed labels were approximations, so escoLabel now records the matched ESCO preferred label rather than the original seed wording. Live re-verification needs network access; no resolver script was committed, so a future refresh must replay the recorded GET request against a pinned ESCO release. A later ESCO release may retire or replace concepts.
